title: Blob Storage
subtitle: Files belong in object storage, and the database keeps only the key
motto: Store bytes where bytes are cheap, and keep the pointer where queries are
keyInsight: Moving files out of the database shrinks its size and backups, but the bytes still cost you bandwidth until clients upload and download directly.

decisions.title: Fail on the upload path, not the storage
decisions.description: The failure frame shows uploads flowing through app servers, because moving the files is not enough if their bytes still take the same path.
decisions.alternatives: Stopping at 'use object storage' would leave the common mistake of proxying every upload untouched.

decisions.title: Show cost and retrieval time together
decisions.description: The cold tier frame reports both the saving and the minutes to read an archived image, since cheaper storage is slower to retrieve.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting only the lower bill would make an archive tier look strictly better.
